frozen_at: 2026-09-08 before construction of historical environmental summaries
purpose: Place the August 2026 atmospheric configuration of Tolima in the limited set of technically eligible August GWIS seasons without treating event counts as a homogeneous occurrence series.

temporal_domain.reason: All historical and 2026 sources contain this complete common UTC window. The supplementary September files are retained for later event-window work and are not used here.

spatial_domain.rule: ERA5 Land grid-cell centre falls uniquely inside the existing Tolima municipality union
spatial_domain.primary_weight: cosine of latitude for each retained grid centre
spatial_domain.sensitivity_weight: equal weight per retained grid centre
spatial_domain.reason: The latitude span is modest but latitude weighting is a transparent approximation to equal-area grid-cell weighting. The equal-weight result is retained as a pre-specified sensitivity.

variables.air_temperature_mean_c: Daily mean of grid-cell hourly 2 metre temperature in degrees Celsius, spatially aggregated with the pre-specified weights.
variables.air_temperature_max_c: Daily maximum of the hourly spatially aggregated 2 metre temperature series in degrees Celsius.
variables.vapour_pressure_deficit_mean_kpa: Daily mean of grid-cell hourly vapour pressure deficit derived from 2 metre temperature and dewpoint, then spatially aggregated.
variables.wind_speed_mean_ms: Daily mean of grid-cell hourly 10 metre wind speed derived from vector components, then spatially aggregated.
variables.wind_speed_max_ms: Daily maximum of the hourly spatially aggregated 10 metre wind-speed series.

formulae.vapour_pressure_kpa: 0.6108 times exp of 17.27 times temperature_c divided by temperature_c plus 237.3
formulae.vapour_pressure_deficit_kpa: saturation vapour pressure at air temperature minus vapour pressure at dewpoint temperature
formulae.wind_speed_ms: square root of zonal wind squared plus meridional wind squared
formulae.negative_vpd_handling: Values smaller than negative 0.005 kPa fail the construction gate. Values from negative 0.005 kPa through zero are set to zero and counted.

seasonal_summaries.mean: Arithmetic mean of the 31 daily values.
seasonal_summaries.p95: Linear 95th percentile of the 31 daily values, retained to describe the high end of the daily distribution and not as a separate hypothesis test.

comparison.target_vs_reference: Report the target seasonal summary, reference-season median, reference minimum and maximum, absolute difference from reference median, and the target rank among the six available seasonal values.
comparison.formal_hypothesis_testing: No null-hypothesis test or causal attribution is planned because the reference set has five historical seasons selected through a technical GWIS-access gate rather than random sampling from a stationary climate population.
comparison.event_count_context: GWIS August event counts are tabulated separately as product-specific operational counts. They are not modelled as wildfire occurrence, outcome, exposure, or proof of equal detection sensitivity across years.

prohibited_interpretations: Causal attribution of ignition, fire spread, area burned, or institutional response.
Claiming that GWIS event counts measure complete wildfire occurrence or are equally detectable across years.
Use of precipitation before the separate accumulated-GRIB reconstruction and validation gate passes.
Pooling the NASA burned-area products or using them as validation of the 2026 GWIS cohort.
